reasons: Lake treatment.field_i_validity is good_law and the scope_note matches the page's controlling-law statement.

reviewed.suggested_tightening: Say no confirmed negative treatment in the disclosed lake record, and note that top-cited progeny audit remains pending unless that audit has been cleared.
